test_pipeline_mixin: test a diffusion pipeline by inheriting PipelineTesterMixin and implementing get_dummy_components and get_dummy_inputs methods
test_ip_adapter_mixin: test IP adapter support on a pipeline by inheriting IPAdapterTesterMixin and running scale zero and non zero tests
test_cache_mixin: test FasterCache or MagCache on a pipeline by inheriting FasterCacheTesterMixin or MagCacheTesterMixin and running inference
test_cpu_offload: test sequential or model CPU offloading on a pipeline using test_sequential_cpu_offload_forward_pass or test_model_cpu_offload_forward_pass
test_save_load: test saving and loading a pipeline locally with test_save_load_local or with float16 precision using test_save_load_float16
